verdict.rationale: Terraform's plan/apply separation, saved plan artifacts, and JSON machine-readable output give an agent a reviewable, gateable change process (verified live via probes), and Terraform Cloud policy-as-code (Sentinel/OPA) plus the official MCP server extend this to AI-agent workflows. However, there is no evidence of built-in least-privilege credential scoping/issuance for agents — that responsibility falls to the cloud provider/IAM layer, not Terraform itself, and -auto-approve can bypass the review gate if misused.
